svg.title: Depth error grows with the square of distance
svg.desc: Line chart of theoretical stereo depth error against distance from 0 to 60 m. Webcam rig (f = 900 px, baseline 15 cm): ±0.74 m at 20 m, ±2.96 m at 40 m, ±4.63 m at 50 m, ±6.67 m at 60 m. KITTI rig (f = 721 px, baseline 54 cm): ±0.26 m at 20 m, ±1.03 m at 40 m, ±1.61 m at 50 m, ±2.31 m at 60 m. 50 m is marked as the 2-second gap at 90 km/h.
